# DocumentMetadata

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains descriptive metadata written to the PDF information and XMP records.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new DocumentMetadata()
new DocumentMetadata(title: string)
new DocumentMetadata(title: string, author: string)
new DocumentMetadata(options: DocumentMetadataOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`author`](#author): The name of the person who created the document
- [`creationDate`](#creationdate): The date and time the document was created
- [`creator`](#creator): The application that created the original content
- [`customProperties`](#customproperties): A collection of custom metadata key-value pairs to embed in the document's Information Dictionary alongside the standard entries.
- [`keywords`](#keywords): Keywords associated with the document.
- [`modifiedDate`](#modifieddate): The date and time the document was last modified
- [`producer`](#producer): The application that converted the document to PDF
- [`subject`](#subject): The subject of the document
- [`title`](#title): The document title
- [`trapped`](#trapped): Indicates whether document-level trapping has been applied for professional printing.

### `keywords`

```typescript
keywords?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Keywords associated with the document. For PDF generation, these are stored as a comma-separated string.

```

```

### `trapped`

```typescript
trapped?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Indicates whether document-level trapping has been applied for professional printing. True means trapped, false means not trapped, undefined means not specified.
